worldcombat.skill.lashout.summary: Strikes harder when weakened. Negative stat stages and harmful native effects fuel its anger; a hit first removes negative stages, then reduces harmful effects.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.use.0: Hit hard right after being weakened
worldcombat.skill.lashout.use.1: Shed every stockpiled lowered stage at once
worldcombat.skill.lashout.use.2: Trade rage for an Attack boost
worldcombat.skill.lashout.description.0: Deals about %1$s physical damage. The power doubling from negative stat stages or harmful native effects is already included.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.description.1: Steps in up to %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, collision radius %3$s blocks; shoves the target back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.description.2: On hit, removes up to %1$s weakening levels, starting with the lowest stat stages and then reducing harmful native effects; reaching zero removes an effect. Vent form also grants %2$s Attack stages for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.vent.on: Vent on: removes up to nine weakening levels on hit and grants an Attack boost; wind-up is three ticks longer and cooldown eight ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.vent.off: Vent off: removes one weakening level on hit, with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.growth.0: At level %1$s the vented power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.growth.1: At level %1$s the vented power rises to %2$s and the rage boost to %3$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.preference.ven: When enabled, a hit removes up to nine weakening levels and boosts Attack, with three extra wind-up ticks and eight extra cooldown ticks. Otherwise it removes one level.
Only steps in against threats this close; a larger value chases a weakened target further.
On: vents on a target as soon as the user carries a negative stage (exactly the doubling window). Off: sorted like an ordinary melee attack.
